data.body:
MERGED AND VERIFIED. Gerrit 1325 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1325) received LLM-Review=+1 [PASS] and Verified=+1 with zero unresolved comments, and merged as ac1123ec6a 'name AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, not AWS_REGION' on gerrit/main.

All four acceptance criteria verified against the MERGED source, not against the pre-merge branch:
1. The LLMConfigError message no longer offers AWS_REGION as a sufficient remedy — it now reads 'or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION / the active profile's config' and adds 'NOTE: AWS_REGION alone does NOT resolve a region'.
2. It names the measured version: 'MEASURED on botocore/boto3 1.43.62, with AWS_DEFAULT_REGION unset and AWS_REGION set, boto3 resolves no region at all' — so the claim is falsifiable rather than folklore, and the message even tells the operator 'if you have only set AWS_REGION that is why you are seeing this'.
3. The docstring and the message now agree with each other AND with infra/compose/docker-compose.yml's review-bot comment, which the docstring cites explicitly as recording the same asymmetry — the in-tree contradiction is gone.
4. The test pins BEHAVIOUR, not prose: test_aws_region_alone_resolves_nothing_and_still_raises uses the REAL boto3 chain (no Session stub), deletes AWS_DEFAULT_REGION with monkeypatch.delenv so it is genuinely ABSENT rather than set-empty, and points AWS_CONFIG_FILE / AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE at nonexistent paths so an ambient ~/.aws/config cannot supply a region and mask the asymmetry. Its docstring states the right thing about its own future: if a later botocore starts honouring AWS_REGION the test goes RED, which is the signal to re-measure and re-word rather than let the claim decay. Mutation-verified during authoring — replacing the region pre-check with 'if False:' produced 'Failed: DID NOT RAISE LLMConfigError', and the mutant was restored before commit.

This ticket also served a second purpose for [rebar:eb6e-f43a-e86b-443a]: as a real change reviewed by the production bot on the pre-cutover Anthropic path, it produced the recorded findings-A baseline (artifact 1aa5-1574-50be-4e65: 0 blocking / 0 advisory / 0 dropped, provider_provenance provider='anthropic', model='anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6'). It was held open for that reason and has now been submitted.
